text:
My boyfriend and I came here at the recommendation of a friend and were very impressed with the food and service. The atmosphere and decor are lovely, and it's nice to go someplace where the music isn't blasting, and we can hear each other talk. As other reviewers have noted, the place has a nice intimate feel.

There were so many delicious options on the menu that we decided to order a lot of food and just take the left overs home. My boyfriend is vegan; and, while I'm still an omnivore, I'm trying to eat a more plant-based diet and may eventually become vegan myself. Places like this make that transition easy with all of the delicious umami flavors and the variety of textures in the dishes. I would definitely recommend this place for omnivores and vegetarians/vegans alike and am bringing an omnivorous friend here for dinner this week. :-)

My only criticism is that it's hard to tell which items are vegan from the dine-in menu. The online ordering menu has vegan items marked with a little red "v." I'm hoping they update the other menu soon to match. In the meantime, I'm sure I can peek at the online menu or ask the server to verify. I considered bumping it down to four stars for this, but I love the food so much that I really want to be sure this place stays open! I just sent them a message on their website to let them know and encourage others to do do the same.

This place is the worst. The one counter woman always has a horrible attitude like you are giving her a hard time just by picking up food there. There is NO HUSTLE from anyone at this restaurant. Everyone is always in the back chatting in a group including the cooks while you are waiting to eat. No matter how good the food is, if the people working at an establishment are unprofessional then it's not worth going there. And god forbid you complain! You will get an ear full from the counter girl. This place is a f-ing joke!

Good Burger.

If you're looking for a solid burger in Boise, look no further.

Came here recently and ordered the bleu burger and the mushroom bacon burger. Both excellent. Also had sides of fries and tater tots. Very good.

Great thing about their burgers is although they come with a lot of toppings, it all stays together when you take a bite. 

Service was friendly, prices were solid. Limited in house seating due to covid.

We are never disappointed with to food or service. Great sushi. My favorite (Tuna nigiri) is simple, but always prepared well with an ample amount of tuna. They are always accommodating with any special requests my kids may have.

We went for Mother's Day.. So the food was outstanding but why did our food courses take so long? The restaurant seemed quiet. And not very full but the courses took very long to come out. Our experience took longer than 3 hours to finish. I wish we could give a better review because I really want to come back and try this experience again.

My husband and I were craving some sandwiches and I was happy to find some great Sub 16 reviews here on Yelp so we stopped in. 

Their menu had great options but you can also build your own sandwich with different meat and cheese choices. I got a regular turkey and provolone with my regular toppings BUT WAIT (!) they had giardiniera too! Since I live in Chicagoland, I was SO excited to discover they had my favorite sandwich topping and that alone was a 5 star rating from me. What sealed the deal though, was the overall flavor oft sandwich. The bread was perfect for a great sandwich and I know the meat and cheese were fresh because they sliced it all right in front of me. It was all delicious! Next time I'm craving a sandwich, you can find me here.

Better than Nashville's hot chicken! Prince's and Hattie B's are yummy but this takes the cake! The chicken is so so good. Fried to perfection! The sides are decent, but won't have you rushing back. I heard that the fish is really good but I fill up on chicken every single time. I also hear good things about the restaurant next door, Pappy's Smokehouse. But like I said, I get the chicken every  single time so I wouldn't know.
It was 50/50. Chicken fried rice was terrible. It was salty, very dry and half cooked rice. Hot and spicy beef was okayish.

This place is incredible.  We've order DoorDash through them at least a dozen times and it's always hot and fresh when it arrives.  Their banner isn't a lie, best gyro my hubs and I have had in town.

Did I mention the baklava?!  Oh man.  I stop in every time I'm in the area.  We love their rolled baklava. 

Super nice owners, and the market is AWESOME!
Great food and service! Love this place - if it stays non smoking there will be many more people coming according to the Nextdoor app and I totally agree and will be back more often.

I literally came here because I was told about the pastries! it did not disappoint, you cant find a good bakery here in Florida like NY 
    Napoleons were awesome even though it wasn't with the traditional custard filling!

Best place ever to eat a sampler! We got the advice from another review here and we didn't regret. Pullet pork, brisket, mc&cheese, and cheddar fries!! Another positive point, we went there almost 1a.m., and even so, the food was delicious! Definitely we will come back for the bacon, unfortunately they dont serve them at night.

It used to be my favorite for fried rice. I went there today the lady in the cashiers was so RUDE and MEAN. She yelled at me because I reminded "don't forget to put fish sauce on FR" she said "don't need to remind them". That was so RIDICULOUS to yelled at costumer who spent their money into your Business!!!! Never Come Back!!!!!!

UPDATE: Taco Circus has moved to a much larger, more commerical location! The dining area is huge, and decorated with blacklight op-art posters and other novelties. (On a recent visit, a life-sized Homer Simpson was disturbed by an inquisitive child and fell off his ledge above a bench in the waiting area; no one was harmed!) 
There's now an expansive bar with plenty of seating, lots of tables and booths, and a wait for tables. The vibe has changed, but still all good - just different: it's louder, less grungy, more polished. There's also an enormous patio filled with colorful picnic tables, the only real nod to the old Circus I saw. Food is still tasty, with generous portions and home-made sauces.
Always a stop when in New Orleans. The staff are always friendly and helpful.  It is an iconic NOLA establishment and you can expect the same great sandwhich each visit.
Came at 2a.m hot food cold drink for 2a.m munchies appreciate the service best late night snack even a chocolate chip cookie thanks for delivery

Great food - we had pizza ( really cheesy). The pasta was wrapped in plastic wrap over the container to keep it good and hot ( appreciate!) The salad was awesome! Fresh and full of everything. We get take out/delivery often and we've never been disappointed.
The customer service was great even though they were busy. We had the eggs Benedict and it was good. The potatoes were the shining star and would definitely recommend.

Shoutout to PokeOno for still delivering an awesome meal with all of this COVID19 craziness happening.  I stopped by last Friday to grab some drinks to-go (this was that wild 80 degree day) and ended up getting a bowl as well.  I was so impressed with the quality of their ingredients in a time when customer numbers must be low.  My bowl had great salmon that tasted really fresh + the most perfect avocado.  They were also taking a lot of sanitary precautions such as wiping down screens between transactions, using a fresh pair of gloves for every customer, etc.  This week restaurant operating restrictions have become even more stringent, but I hope they can stay open for takeout.  Do your part and follow social distancing guidelines, and then get yourself a treat from PokeOno using an approved method if you are able!  This is a great local business to support.

First of all - the service is 5 stars, they are friendly and helpful. Kudos to them. As for the food, it is a bit underwhelming- good presentation but it has little taste. Maybe that's what Tex-Mex food is supposed to be? I am not sure. Thankfully they have a nice hot sauce bar. Habanero sauce gave a good kick to my chimichanga. I don't like the loud pop music and the neon lighting bothers me. Maybe I will try this place again, but not anytime soon.
Terrific food and as good service. Troy makes the experience even better and don't forget the heavenly custard!

Their Monday sandwich special is a great deal, it comes with whatever sandwich they choose and any of their 12 oz beers. I got the Korean fried chicken sandwich and it was pretty tasty although I think they could have taken it out of the fryer a little sooner, the batter on the chicken was verging on too dark. I also wish their fries were a little crispier, but the spicy house made ketchup is great. Our server was super friendly and helpful.

Great bbq. Full bar.  
Got the brisket fries and my friend got the pulled pork sandwich.  Would definitely go back. G
Everything was really spaced out and felt very safe
Was pleased with the quality of food and good service. I cant wait to return with my family again! Lots of unique and different menu items to choose from, including low calorie healthy options.
Terrible service for take out. They give you a time then ignore it. This happened to at least a couple of customers while i was waiting. They just dont care.

This was the worst dining experience I've ever had. We were seated for 20 minutes and had to ask the waiter to come take our order. It took another 20 minutes to receive five waters. The waiter originally brought us two???? We had to ask for the rest. One of our food orders was wrong and no one ever brought the smoothie or milkshake that our table ordered. They gave us excuses about how they were slammed and had new staff. I would usually be understanding in that case but no one ever gave a genuine apology and even had an attitude with us. I wouldn't care if our food took a while or service was somewhat slow but this was beyond belief. How do you bring a table of five only two waters after sitting there for 40 minutes?? The food was mediocre too but that's just Denny's for you.
Terrible. Terrible. So bad. They are always out of everything and the nachos are just crumbs. Stay away.

Food was great but service was far below average! 
Spectacular view! 
Classy restaurant! 
Clean big and spacious! 
Excellent patio seating! 
Dreadful service 
Fresh and delicious food
Great quick food, healthy, super clean, and the lemonade varieties are awesome!  They make everything to order and honor all requests.

My husband and myself dined here to celebrate his birthday. Our experience was exceptional. Fogo de chao is doing everything to make the guest experience worthwhile especially during COVID. They require mask when not seating and gloves when going to the salad bar. My husband and myself never went without a full glass of water or wine. The servers are extremely polite and attentive and really made his birthday dinner special. The food was without a doubt delicious and cooked to perfection. For the both of us our bill was around $200 which some may think of as pricey, but I believe it was worth every penny. Excellent job fogo de chao keep up the great work!
The chocolate moose cake is the best. The best thing about this cake is you can eat a lot and doesn't feel full and taste really good.

This place is absolutely incredible. Yesterday I went with a good friend of mine and it was delicious. For $28 you get to have unlimited hotpot and bbq for two hours. It's doesn't seem like much time to eat, but the grill does work fast. We waited no more than a minute or so for anything we ordered. Our servers, as well as other members of the wait staff were prompt and attentive. Drinks were always refilled and there was always someone checking on us. The hot pot was beautifully done, we both got Szechuan. I'm quite good with spice and she is not, but the broth wasn't overly spicy at all, it was also perfectly salted. As far as decor, the restaurant is beautiful and the bathrooms were extremely clean. With the quality of the food, as well as the diligence of the staff, the owner has a recipe for continued success if all remains consistent. This will be my go to place when I'm in the area. I'll be back in two weeks!

I like the fact that you can enjoy some good food while sitting and enjoying your favorite artist, but the service was just eh... i had better. Our server took forever with our food and when it came to refills or ordering more food, forget it! There was no luck with that, so I guess we will just continue to be parched and hungry as the waiters walk past us numerous times while we attempt to get your attention. 

I came with my boyfriend to see Jon B and the show was great, but I didn't like how many people came in late and got in the way of us watching the show. 

We also were seated by the loudest women ever who talked the entire time and were so annoying. 

As far as the food, we got the chicken wings and they were very tasty and we shared the egg rolls, wasn't a big fan of them, and we had the Bavarian pretzels with different dipping sauces like a cream cheese, some type of mustard and I think a buttercream. The pretzels were just okay, but the dipping sauces tasted really weird and had a strange after taste. 

I would try this place but just go to the restaurant because it seemed to be more intimate and like it would be a better time versus coming here to see a show again and being annoyed with the people and the waitstaff that are terrible.
Such amazing bbq for St. Louis! Pulled pork, brisket and ribs are always so good! I've been here so many times and will be back a lot!! I would highly recommend them for some good STL bbq.

We all came her for brunch.  I apparently was last to the part on this stop because the rest of my party had been going for other meals and each one they said was great. 
Parking from what I seen was street- We came at open so we didn't have trouble.  But keep that in mind when you come.  They have a huge patio- I saw a dog or two but since I didn't sit out there not sure how dog friendly the patio is.  Inside was a nice large space.  Nothing over the top or trendy, just well decorated.  They had unlimited mimosas and bloody Mary bars but since I didn't partake I'm not sure the cost.  The table kept bringing back glasses of juice with huge berries and melons for the server to top off with bubbly.  I will definitely grab this next time! 
The food was good.  I like that they didn't make anything to fussy for the brunch menu.  I went with steak and eggs and it was well seasoned and cooked how I ordered.  The others had a pulled pork I think, and something off the kids menu.  It looked fantastic and everyone had great things to say about their food (we aren't really "sharers").  
I will definitely at this to my brunch repertoire and I will have to try the rest of the menu soon!

This place is super special. Love their menu and everything I've had is super yummy! Their jackfruit is on point and I love there pecan chocolate cups! Perfect for vegans and non-vegans!! Let me tell you, everyone is so nice and sweet too!

Visited for lunch with my daughter & granddaughter. The atmosphere was beautiful, service was good and the sushi was delicious! 

The lunch special was a great deal, my daughter and I got two okay rolls and clear soup. The clear soup was the BEST I have ever had at a restaurant. The okay roll was so delicious; it had fried crab and cream cheese together which was just perfect, on top was crispy tempura chips with spicy sauce and a yummy sweet sauce that also balanced each other out so well! I will definitely get this roll again especially on the lunch deal, can't beat it!

We also ordered a specialty roll called  Rising Sun which was great as well but I thought the flavor profile of the Okay roll was better.  The Rising Sun Roll had Alaskan snow crab, cucumber and crispy smoked salmon skin inside and on top raw white fish, spicy mayo, eel sauce, yum yum sauce, scallions and red tobiko. The salmon skin was the best part about the roll, it was so good and different. It had a great crispy texture and smoky flavor that went together amazingly with the sushi dipped in soy. 

Can't wait to go and try allot more of their rolls!

Been to this place a couple of times. The quality of the food and service seem to worsen over time. One time I had an egg that was sooo salty that it felt like I just ate a spoon full of salt. Another time I had a dumpling with a piece of hair in it and the older Asian lady server just joked that the hair is too long to belong to anyone of the cooks , all I wanted was a "Sorry about that" but nope  she just took the dumpling and laughed like it's not their fault. This place use to be good.
Fast, friendly and the food is consistently good. There's a drive thru, but it's best for cars. My Ford Excursion couldn't fit.

We love the convenience of being able to walk here, but it's literally a 50/50 chance that we'll actually enjoy the food. The wings are always pretty good (sometimes amazing, sometimes just decently good) but the pizza is so hit or miss. Sometimes it's great, sometimes it's terrible - as in the slices have already  dried up and separated from each other before we get it home terrible. I think we've actually had to throw it away a couple times, which is a travesty because we are pizza worshippers. So if you catch them on an on-day you'll be v happy but catch them on an off-day and good luck to you. Great for gamblers though!!

We have had 2 bad experiences in a row her now.  First time pizza had so many bald spots on it. My boyfriend did not check it at pick up. Second time something went wrong on the wed site while ordering. It did not let me review the order and once placed. It was like my order got mixed with another order. There were 4 pizzas ins read of 2 and they were all wrong. I CALLED THE STORE IMMEDIATELY AND CANCELLED THE ORDER. THERE WAS NOT TIME TO EVEN GET THE DOUGG OUT TO START MAKING THE PIZZAS. I tried to replace my order over the phone. I was told I had to order on line again. Did that.  It went fine. I told my bf what had happened. So that he could double ck the pizzas when picked up. The pizzas were pretty sparse again. My bf asked the female cashier about it. His pizza was double canadian bacon, double mushroom and pineapple. He asked her if that looked like double mushrooms. Her reply was there a mushroom right there. He asked her again. Does this look like a double order of mushrooms. She says I see mushrooms.  He asked for her manager.  My bf explains the situation.  The managers reply is. Well it cost me to make your pizzas. It is what it is. I immediately cancelled the wrong order. They did not even have time to get the dough out. Let alone make the pizzas. I don't know if there is new management there now. We have eaten there for years and always been happy, but twice in a row. Then have a manag5act the way he did. WE WILL NOT BE GOING BACK.

While I worked/lived in Philly for a year and a half, the Dutch Eating Place was my choice 3 out of 5 days a week, maybe more depending on the specials!

I've had the burger, sloppy joes, a bucket load of turkey with mashed potatoes and the pancakes that are so large it was folded in quarters in the box.  

Yum - I finished it all without a togo box - which explains why I never had room to try the famous apple turnover!  Next time I will.

Excellent upscale Italian in the northern Philadelphia suburbs. A bit pricey but worth  it for the atmosphere and quality food. Been here a few times  and never had anything that wasn't delicious. This visit pleased with Caesar salad, eggplant appetizer, bronzino and Ossobucco. Want to go back to try more oof their reportedly excellent pastas.

Went for restaurant week, thinking we could check it out, and they would have their best of the best as a showcase.    Not so.  My date and I had arrived, ordered drinks, and the three course restaurant week selections.  Our drinks arrived but still seemed slow.  Then we waited and waited.  Service seemed slow and unaware of our waiting.  We waited.   Interestingly, they seem to have plenty of staff buzzing around.  First course came, then we waited and waited.  Second course came.   Good food.  Not great.  Good.  Then our desserts.   Delicious. BUt then we waited for our check.   The experience was 2 hours.   Not a busy place at the time either.   

To duplicate another past review I just read, I dont understand what this place is supposed to be.   Is it casual dining?  Great, then why the 2 hours, and the food seems a bit on the high side if its casual.  If its not casual, and more classy, then why is the waitstaff in various clothing.   Some in long pants and dress shirts, others in shorts and tee shirts, other is workout pants?  And it was loud, so be prepared.

Meh.  Weird or eclectic?  Maybe just not sure what personality it wants to be.  Either way, I wont be back.

I work at a bank nearby and I came here for lunch,  I let the lady know that we were on an hour lunch and she had everything out to us very quickly.  Refilled our drinks without asking, very pleasant restaurant!

I love love LOVE this place. It's so clean. The employees are fast, friendly, and knowledgeable about their dishes. I love the fact that you can all ahead and order and drive up to the drive thru and just pick it up. My go to is their Cuban sandwich. Delicious. Really great Cuban.
Was driving by and found this place. Absolutely amazing tri-tip sandwich with avocado and bacon. Yummy! The best service, friendly staff.
Bruh... just look at the pics of the food. That's exactly what you get here. Greatness. GET TRUFFLE SALT ON YOUR FRIES. OMG!!! Lol
Don't bother ... stick with Pizza Star I was totally disappointed... not worth it at all

After decades of customer loyalty we find that store changes impel us to shop elsewhere.  We reserve Sunday mornings around 7:00 AM as optimal shopping for two reasons:  it is easy to maneuver around the major road project in front of the store and more importantly, fewer people in the store at that time reduces Covid-19 risk.  As we were ready to check out (approx. 8:15 AM) there were no available cashiers... self check-out being all that was available.  There were 9 people crowded in the small self check area and no possibility of social distancing.    We asked staff if someone could open a check-out and were informed that a register person was not scheduled until 9:00 AM and that that was the new store policy.  If my wife hadn't been tired at that point and for the fact I didn't want to subject her to a repeat shopping trip elsewhere...I would've left both carts there on the floor and walked out.  The irony is that when we were finishing up, we heard a call for a front checker over the PA!  In short we are very disappointed with this short sighted policy that forces people into too close contact to what? Save a buck?!.  We have no choice but to find a grocery store that does the right thing and has checkers available on Sunday morning.

LOVED everything about this meal! Fantastic service from start to finish by our server Dayton! Great wine list and absolutely divine food. Don't miss the fried green tomatoes and shrimp or the house salad dressing! Nice ambience and friendly staff  If you're In New Orleans and you're a foodie, it's worth the trip!

Staff was kind and helpful and the COVID measures in place made me feel safe and good about going to pick food up! Food is great for a fast food type restaurant and I really respect the company as a whole. The line was very long, but the staff was great about getting it down and getting us in and out quickly!!

Their Chicken Rice soup literally nursed my Mom back to health. She was in the hospital for 7 days and all she wanted was the chicken soup from new china. They offer it with noodles or rice. It's delicious. Thank you New China for helping my Mom recover from her illness.

So the complaint 2 months ago, you must of had a bad day. Parking is $9 for valet and the parking lot right next to it is $7 for 1 hour or $15 for 6 hours. The Winery is not in a bad spot. It's about a 10 minute walk from downtown.

This place deserves no less than a 4 star. The service is great. The wine selection vast and the food is pretty good. Our server Samantha was great. She explained everything and took care of use. 

If you don't come for the food they have a tour and you can purchase wine. The scotch and whiskey selection is pretty good. Not a lot of option but high quality liquors for a good price. 

Highly recommend you stop on by for the tour or the food. Or just grab some wine and enjoy the sunset and the skyline view.

The burgers are so incredibly delicious! It was nice to walk and be greeted by the staff. They took care of us the entire night. The music and atmosphere was on point. The only disappointing factor for us was the fries. Maybe we got a bad batch, but they were slightly warm and not crispy. The burger made up for it all though. We will totally be back to try other selections on the menu!

Bagels were amazing, as expected. Breakfast sandwhich was horrible. Microwaved egg and bacon, the egg was poorer quality than mcdonalds. Coffee was also not great, not fresh. For a place that only does breakfast I expected better.

We come no Nashville fairly often and we always try to find new places. The recent Covid restrictions forced us to widen our net a little bit and that's how we found this place. Great atmosphere, great food, great staff. I had the escargot and rack of lamb and my wife had a salad and the foie gras. Both were amazing. make sure you make a reservation way ahead of time, especially during Covid restrictions.

The bottom line: great place to eat and enjoy live music, great atmosphere, great service. Easily walkable from anywhere near Broadway. Make sure to make a reservation.

I went here for the first time for lunch recently and this place was so cool. They remade a shotgun house into a restaurant/bar and it's awesome! I got the Dr. Seuss burger and it was juicy and huge you will not leave hungry! I sat at the bar and got to watch them make my food and it was all extremely clean. The chefs and hostess were all welcoming and accommodating.

This place was a beauty to behold. We fortunately snuck in just ahead of the 9am crowd! The breads were being made fresh on site and were so fun to watch the bakers at work. The staff was so friendly and the food was great! I only took off one star because they need more seating- there were people standing around holding plates of food - not really fair to take a star away though because it is obviously a sign that people love the place!

Ordered quickly with an employee outside but once in line through drive thru, it was exactly an hour wait! We almost left twice due to the very long wait time but a car kept leaving so we would move forward. No apologies when we got to the window. Paid and about to drive off but figured we better check out order. We only received 1 of our 2 orders of chicken joy and pancit. We knocked on the window and the cashier asked what we needed. We told her that part of our order is missing and she told us u have ur 2 piece. We were like no, we paid $24 for 2 two-pieces plus a mango pie and missing the other half. She took our receipt, closed the window, then 5 minutes later gave us the rest of our order without an apology. Needless to say, we wouldn't be back to this one. We much rather go to the one in Jacksonville or elsewhere. There really was no reason for the hour wait! The food was okay. I could be home and just cook my own in the time they serve it as I am Filipino. They need to learn from Chick fil A's drive thru system. We were very disappointed at our experience at this particular store as we love Jollibee's food!

Total dissatisfaction and disappointment!  I purchased two, pick 2 soup salad. The cup of soup was less then half full and the chicken Caesar salad was full of the hard spine which was not fit to eat and I counted 2 pieces of chicken in one salad and 4 small pieces not the normal slices in the other. All this for $23.00 what a rip off!  I won't be back.
This taco Bell has the rudest staff. The lady who just took my order looks like she just woke up and she didn't even care to take my order correctly.

We recently moved to Carpinteria, and we have frequented this restaurant several times. The staff is warm and delightful. The food is absolutely delicious. We have tried most things on the menu by now. The tuna and salmon are especially amazing oh and the fish tacos too! The cocktails are fantastic. I would highly recommend this great restaurant.
This is place is pretty good.  I had a decent cuban sandwich, and their pastries are tasty.  If you are in the area, definitely worth checking out.  Nothing stellar, but good service and good food.

Excellent food and even better service. Gerard greeted us, took our order, delivered our food to our table, and was running around happily checking on all customers. If he isn't the manager, he should be. He took pride in his work, all with a smile on his face. 

I ordered a power plate with tofu, yams, and Mexican rice. Delicious. The chips and salsa are always top notch at all Sharky's locations. 

I wish a Sharky's would open up in Northern Santa Barbara County and/or Southern SLO County.

My daughter and I decided to try this place this morning, as we were both wanting somewhere we've never been. We'll be back. Extremely friendly wait staff.. great food. I had the chicken poblano crepes... yum. My daughter had peach waffles. Both of us were satisfied.. and the price was extremely reasonable. Tables are well spaced out, and employees were masked... as were customers coming and going.

Great place and a must go to for dinner if you are boarding a plane on the next day. Waiter was great and food was excellent.  Noise was high though due to the bar crowd.  This place has changed greatly since 15 years ago to the better.

Sweet Jesus, this changed my life. Got the cheesesteak with whiz and onions, plus the cheese fries, and a vanilla shake with caramel... so good I went back the next day. So. Good. Omg. GO THERE RIGHT NOW. Our waitresses were so sweet too. Great place! This was my first cheesesteak and I don't think anywhere else can live up.

Food is fantastic, service is world-class.  Came with my bachelor party before my wedding and I literally have no complaints.  Oysters with mushrooms are a must.  Sit in the main dining room for the big room ambiance.
Had food delivered to our room and selected Margherita pizza, meatballs, grilled chicken salad   Absolutely the best pizza and meatballs. Grilled chicken on the salad was freshly grilled. Delicious!
Enjoyed a wonderful brunch in this cute little cafe. Food is fantastic and the coffee is delicious!  Great customer service and plenty of menu choices. Highly recommend!

I have been here for dinner couple times and can honestly say that the food is tasty. The 2 start review is due to the poor service that is provided by the Resturant is extremely slow. The guys may be nice and all but to get 3 appetizers in 45 minutes is insane!! The Resturant is only 1/2 full. Hope that in the next hour or so we get our 2 entrees and rice!! Help me God

Decent food.  Not a great value for the amount of money my family and I spent.  Not to shred the.  Appreciate the hustle and the wood fired pizza.  It was good. Not life changing but good.  The bruschetta was not very flavorful to be honest and very pricey for the amount you get.  Was not worth the money.  The pizza was again good but not worth the $15 each. For a wood fired pizza.  

Wish them all the luck in the world but I won't be back. Cheers all the same.

This little gem on Main Street in Carmel is something special. Met a friend for lunch on their front patio on an unseasonably warm and sunny day. The food was excellent as was the service! There's a lot of low country cuisine, but also things like an excellent chicken salad. Full bar. Heaters poised and ready to go for colder days. The best part was the Key Lime Cake for dessert (and saying it was best is saying something-the crab soup and chicken salad was yummy!)- it was unbelievably tasty AND beautifully presented-for only $6!! I can't wait to go back!

Our service was terrible. I had to share a water with my husband because we sat with empty glasses for so long. We waited a very long time for our order to even be taken. Then we waited forever to get our salads & dinner.  Our server was gone for very long periods of time. My husband's steak was well done, not medium. Mine was cooked the correctly but dry.  Salad good, dessert good. Shrimp cocktail good but definitely nothing like St. Elmos.  Bread good. Our reservation was for 7. We did not have dinner until 8:30. We would have been fine with waiting for salads and dinner if she would have kept our beer, wines, and waters filled up. Gave up on ordering cocktails cause it took so long to get one. Ridiculous to not even have water to sip on.  
Definitely not the service and food  you would expect for the $$$$ way overpriced. 
Will not return.  Will not recommend to anyone else.
Meats were dry. Ribs were tough,  sauces and weres subpar.  Best thing we had were the green beans

We had an outstanding dinner here tonight.  Sat outside.  We shared an escargot appetizer and each of had the roasted chicken entree. It was fabulous.   The service was superior and our waiter Josh was very attentive, friendly, knowledgeable and professional.   The best part for me and my husband is that they had Kronenbourg Blanc which we love.  
We will go back again !!!

Awesome food! Awesome staff! Awesome experience! I am not a vegan and gave this place a try, it's amazing. From the ease of ordering to the quick service it's awesome. The food was delicious! Highly recommended!

10th St Diner is our go-to vegan restaurant. I would eat it every night. It doesn't have much of an atmosphere, so we almost always order takeout. But the food far surpasses any other vegan option nearby. Service is quick and the people are friendly. My boyfriend likes to try their varying options on the menu, which we always enjoy, but I absolutely have to order the burger (better than meat), potato salad (so creamy and home-y), and chocolate cake (gigantic portion) every time. This place is so good. Side note but important- I do try and eat healthy, but I'm actually not even vegan. It's just that tasty.

Cute place to get a "Nashville feel" while visiting. Ordered iced coffee and the East Nasty. Did not wait for long as service was very quick and my coffee was surprisingly awesome for a place focused on biscuits. My meal, on the other hand, was decent. Essentially it was a biscuit with chicken and gravy but the chicken was so greasy I felt gross afterwards. If you can handle this food, I recommend it.

We ordered takeout tonight and we were disappointed. We loved Pho 9 when it opened and ate there a number of times. We hadn't been for a while just because life got busy. It's definitely gone downhill if tonight's meal is any indication. We ordered first the appetizer of summer rolls with bbq pork and peanut sauce. They were delicious, full of flavor and the sauce was yummy!
Our meals,not so much. My husband got the chicken with garlic sauce and the chicken pieces were tough and the meal had very little flavor. 
I ordered the Pad Se Lew; I wanted to order the Pad Thai but they told me they can't make it non spicy because the sauce is premade. The noodles were dry and the dish had an unpleasant under taste. The shrimp in it were plentiful and tasty but the rest of the dish was really not good. Pho 9 charges more than similar restaurants and I don't mind paying additional for better food. This is not so any longer here.

This place was so so good! I got the fish tacos and holy moly I wish I lived closer so I could get them again!
My husband ordered the calamari and the fish n chips because we always say that whenever he gets calamari as an entree it's never enough. Well this place had a huge appetizer of calamari and he couldn't even finish his fish n chips which tasted delicious! The tarter sauce was not like normal tarter sauce which we both really liked!
We also ordered an appetizer of the dinner rolls and these rolls were so soft and doughy!
I'm giving this a 4 stars only because the service was kind of slow, they didn't clear any extra plates until we were almost done and we ordered 2 appetizers. 
The food however was great and I can't wait to go back again and try something new!

We go to LBC all the time. Their food is awesome and the beer selection is great. There is one bartender who makes the whole experience even better, I believe her name is Nicky? She has a very thick accent. Super sweet, very friendly, always running around making sure all her customers are taken care off. This place would get 5 stars except for tonight's experience. There were two blonde girls working and they both seemed irritated in general and not very friendly at all. Only one TV at the bar had the Tampa Bay Lightning game on because it was trivia night... I feel they could have turned one TV off trivia as this is a very important time for Tampa bay lightning history. I understand this place isn't primarily a sports bar but when only 8 people are playing the game(with annoying music) and the rest are watching the game it would make more sense. Hopefully the next few games they will have more TVs showing it and not be irritated when asked about it. It's always a 5 star review however when Nicky is taking care of us.

The donuts we obviously not fresh, damn near cold. They were out of coffee, and donut holes. The line was a mile long and the wait was over 20 minutes. Disappointed in the Fenton Krispy Kreme. Next time, I'll save gas money and go to Express Mart for my bakers dozen. Love you, bye.

The food here is unbelievable.  Everything is so delicious, it's hard to make a choice.  The atmosphere is warm and friendly.  They also have a great beer selection, outdoor seating, and AMAZING desserts!

Went last night. Music was great. DJ was Definelty on point with the music . They charged both my friend and I 20 dollars cover at the door, considering that the place closed about an hour and half later. Ordered hookah and it never came.

Worst restaurant I have been to so far in New Orleans. The bread was stale. The charbroiled oysters were extremely grainy and inconsistent (one order at the table was overcooked and dried out, ours was cooked okay but was very bland and seemed equal parts sand to oyster). The wedge salad wasn't bad, but they forgot to add the fried oysters we asked for (probably for the best in hindsight). We had a party of 8 and everybody received their food at different times, about 5 minutes apart, so I'm not sure if there was only one cook today, but that's not acceptable. The poor waitress I am sure did the best she could. Avoid this place at all costs. We came here on the recommendation of a local bartender and now I'm wondering whether he really didn't like us or if he just has awful taste. Dude could tie a mean bow-tie though, so it must be the former, right?
Worst desi food in the city. We were only 3 guys on Friday night. We order bunch of stuff, nothing was good.

Brazilian Flavor in Downtown S.B.
After becoming acquainted with the food of Brazil on a recent family vacation, I sought out a restaurant to recreate our culinary experiences here on the Central Coast. 

Living in San Luis Obispo County, I can say with certainty, Brasil Arts Cafe (BAC) is the closest Brazilian restaurant to us! We were craving some cheesy Pao De Queijo (Brazilian Cheese Bread -- just eat it) and the comfort of salty Feijoada. 

Brasil Arts Cafe fits in well with Downtown Santa Barbara, offering healthy juice and smoothie choices at the counter to-go, as well as favorable menu options for calorie counters. Really though, what drew us to BAC was the authentic Brazilian cuisine. 

If you're local, keep an eye out for weekend specials -- like all-you-can-eat Feijoada! 

I recommend ordering whatever you feel adventurous enough to try. It is authentic and delicious, so I recommend ordering a Brazilian dish you've never tried before, but that sounds like something you'd enjoy regularly -- for example, if you love steak, try the Picanha. 

For dessert, don't forget the Mousse de Maracuja (Passion Fruit Mousse), sweet, tangy, creamy and airy it is a true delight! 

BAC also serves as a Brazilian cultural center of sorts, with traditional martial arts and drum classes held in the back. If you see people walking through dressed as such, don't be alarmed. BAC is a Brazilian haven located in the middle of Downtown Santa Barbara. For us here in San Luis Obispo, we are gr

What a wonderful and refreshing experience @ this location. Food was truly excellent and the service and the kindness that was extended to us was truly on par if not higher. We were fortunate to have "William" as our waiter; he was very kind and caring and made the visit that much better. We were both very comfortable and left feeling great. Food was 2 thumbs up. Manager on sight was extremely attentive and frequently checked up on us. Cashier, "Diamond" was very polite and kind. Truly an A+ experience. This location is truly very clean and very well run; we would return again. Kudos to the "Food Preparation" team - everything was done just right and tasted fresh.

Ordered curb side and the quality of the food was not the same. The Spinach dip was watery, rice and beans, mahi hai tacos and jerk wings were cold. I only live ten minutes from this restaurant. So there's no reason why my food should of been cold. Not to mention the fact that I waited ten minutes for my food to be brought out to me. Highly disappointed

I have been a faithful customer of this Toots for years. Tonight my to-go order included burnt wings (literally black burnt skin), and an order of french fries w/bits of fried shrimp mixed in and a fishy taste from being cooked together. All of this occured after my to-go order took almost 40 min (I waited 20 min after I got there to pick it up) when I was told over the phone it would take 15 minutes. I waisted time, money, and threw more than half my food away. Horrible experience.
Best place in town to bring your laptop and enjoy the coffee shop atmosphere. Perfect spot in downtown Dunedin!

Let me tell you about this anchor burrito has CHICKEN FRIED STEAK. Who thinks of that! Pair that Bitchin burrito with one of Shawns fantastic bloody Mary's and you will have a better morning than that time you woke up next to a regrettable decision. Thank you Shawn for the Bitchin hospitality in these crazy times!!! I'll be definitely be back!
The Salmon needs to be more fresh at the $21.00 pricing. Tikka Marsala dish. Otherwise, my $65.00 delivery was wonderful.
The best place for crepes a lot for your money as well I loved them then the tornado came through and the closed

This was my first experience at Pastiche...I'd heard rave reviews...and I certainly was not disappointed!  I was greeted at the door by smiling employees, and seated immediately. Robert, our waiter, introduced himself  at the table, handed us menus and told us about the specials. He took our drink orders and returned with them promptly. He inquired  about appetizers, and my girlfriend and I decided to share the spinach/artichoke dip. Yummy!!  More than enough for two.  Definitely perfect for four. Our chicken entrees were served piping hot and were delicious! Quite difficult to decide on dessert...but...the chocolate brownie with coffee ice cream was delish!!  Truly loved everything and will definitely return again. Really loved the little white lights draped across the  ceiling, and the background Christmas music.

This place is legit. My boyfriend ordered the "Indian spice" level and was able to devour it. I struggled to get through their most mild spice level. But still enjoyed every bite. When they saw how much I was sweating they brought me out a complementary yogurt to help me mix in with my food to cut the spice. We tried a little bit of everything and I'll definitely be back (come hungry--we rolled out of there).

Also, if you are adventurous and like to stray away from your typical chicken masala this is the place to go. There are so many things on the menu that I had never heard of before. The goat dishes were my favorite and it was fun to blindly order the dessert, try to guess the flavors and how it was made, and then look up to see if I gotten them right afterward.

The food quality has declined here quite a bit during the pandemic time.  Both wings and pizza are mediocre at best.  The pizza used to be very fresh and less oily. The service has been decent,  but the value is no longer there.

Talk about wow!!!! This place is excellent! Had the smoked salmon Benedict! Hangover hash browns! Biscuit and bacon gravy! One of my best decisions in life,(besides my wife and kids)! Carissa was an amazing waitress and very informative! If you are in the area most definitely stop by

Food is great! Will keep ordering from here, have gotten delivery through their site- they have messed up the order slightly a few times which is why I give 3 stars - examples are delivering a tuna salad with no tuna and then taking 25 minutes to deliver the tuna to fix the order instead (I'm okay with mess ups like that but the fact it took so long to deliver to fix it and it just delivering tuna) or putting some wrong stuff on a wrap. The problem is more attention to detail for whoever is making the food itself, will be calling from now on to place an order to make sure it's right because the food is still really good!

Maybe it was an off night but this placewas terrible.  Where do I start? We order two beers, a wine and one mixed drink. The beers came out ten minutes before the glass of wine and a drink.  So we just looked at our beers while we waited for a glass of wine and one mixed drink! Most bars are organized to bring out all the drinks so they arrive at the same time. The service was terrible as the waitress was too distracted to fully give her attention to us while we ordered. Ordering the Calamari should have been the sign that things were going to be bad. The plate was overcooked and dry and a large portion being tentacles.  For dinner it was one pizza and three roast beef sandwiches.  The pizza came out immediately while the roast beef took an additional twenty minutes.  Until I complained that we were still waiting for our food there was no action Again, normally all the food comes out together.  . Secondly, can someone tell the cook that Au Jus is NOT BROWN GRAVY! There was so much of this placed on our sandwiches that it was more like a sloppy Joe. it was swimming in it. Lastly,  the wine in my opinion was over priced. $12 for a generuc wine (or $48 for a.botttle ) I've been there for pizza and that is good but the rest was terrible. Good luck.

I agreed to try Reforma as a change of pace and set it up as our weekly date night. This was a very disappointing experience. There were several problems but I think the biggest problem is that the bartenders do not taste what they are serving and the chef doesn't either. I was lost when I received my barrel aged margarita and it tasted like pure lime juice, but the limes were either old, or they were over squeezed so that the juice was bitter. That same juice was used for the replacement margaritas and again it dominated the flavor.

The next problem was the ceviche which also had that juice in the mix. The fish was also disappointing and had the texture of canned tuna. It just continued downhill from there.

I'm not sure where the problem lies here, but no one appears to be monitoring what goes to the customer. I'm not normally one to complain, but my hope is that someone at the restaurant sees this and has enough pride in their product to figure out a way to improve. I know I won't be going back.
Scoot over to this Scotty's right now!! Craft beers are only $2, talks are $3, domestics are $1!! Special prices on wine too!  Hurry- they're closing forever on Monday!

Omg Loved this place. On the way to the beach called in our order. The people working there were all nice and helpful making sure I got everything. The veggie sandwich was super yummy. The bread nice and soft and all the veggies crunchy. 
DI I say how easy it was. 
We will be going back. 
One suggestion. It would be great to look at a menu/ website somewhere. The pic is a little hard to see. 
Thanks

My family and I are from out of town and we came across this restaurant on yelp and decided to give it a try. We were pleased with the food and and the friendly service. Lisa was our server and she was great. She gave us the 411 on things to do while we were visiting from San Antonio Texas. They're menu was limited do to COVID-19. They are best known for their award winning tamales which she allowed us to sample. I also was informed by a local who came in, that the fish soup is awesome. The place is small, clean a charming, located in a business square. The prices are moderate, about 8 bucks per plate. Overall we had a great experience.

I've tried most Indian restaurants in the city and I come back to this place over and over again. It's by far the best for takeout. I've tried making palak paneer like theirs and it's never the same. It's delicious! Get it! I've been doing a lot of portion control this year and one order usually gets me 3 meals. Recently I froze my leftovers and had it again 2 weeks later and it was still delicious. I've also had their samosas, parathas, garlic naan, tandoori chicken, Chicken korma, and paneer makhani and would get any of those again. Try it! You won't regret it! Also, their gulab jamun were good for dessert !

I did order their Channa chaat and was under whelmed so stick to the rest of the items!

Horribly run.  I've been sitting in here waiting 45 minutes so far for my $5 box and still haven't gotten it. Also, I've experienced them closing early (30 to 45 minutes early) because they don't want to work anymore.

Slow. Lazy. Bad.

Place is small so if there are loud people in the tiny room, that is what you will hear.  I ordered hot roast beef sandwich that had too much of the mayo on it.  My grandson has the hamburger and he said it tasted like propane or surface it was cooked on.  My granddaughter had fettuccine that she said waS good.  Service was good.  No need to return.

The people have said it:  Bistrot is a Philly gem, and one of my go-to favorites for special occasions ('cuz $$$).
My one time here is honestly my best dining experience as of yet, for Bistrot La Minette checks all the boxes:

Warm, top-notch service. 
Inviting, cozy atmosphere (lots of wood) that works across dates, friends, and family. 
Delicious food.  Simple, but artfully prepared. I doubt you could get anything bad here, and I do not say that lightly.

The layered mille dessert with the strawberries is on my short list of most memorable desserts I've ever had.  The delicate textures of creamy to crisp...it's perfection.  

Absolutely fantastic.

Dude that makes the pizza tells incorrect times to come pick up and then has messed up my order on 3 different occasions which has resulted in me waiting in the restaurant for 20+ minutes waiting another pizza and never get anything in compensation in return. Pizza is good but the service is Horrible.

I've been here twice now, but I would definitely go at least once a week if I wasn't drowning in student debt. This place is freaking good. The first time, my friend and I got the egg salad with the anchovy on top (extra charge), salami, and deluxe hummus with pita bread. The egg salad with anchovy was one of the best bites of food I've ever had. I think the anchovy's saltiness added the perfect balance to the creaminess of the egg salad and the crunchiness of the bread. I'm a big texture person obviously lol. 
I was looking forward to their hummus because I heard they made it in-house and it definitely did not disappoint! So far, I've tried the King of Kings one and the Deluxe (+$4) and they're honestly both amazing, but if you're a big lamb person, I would recommend the Deluxe. I also like that their pita bread doesn't have a pocket in the middle as most I've seen, but is dense but still fluffy if that makes sense. 
Will definitely go back to try more things!
The food was amazing. The service was not. There was only one person working at the front counter. Instead of handling the people as they came he was more concerned with his phone.

Great local Texas BBQ. I've enjoyed watching these folks grow and they're clicking on all cylinders now. Great Brisket and a nice variety of extra items like Armadillo Eggs and a humongous burrito!!!  

Good folks working here and I would highly recommend visiting them! 

Thanks!

Wow super good Ramen here. Small place in a strip mall. But many choices of Ramen combinations. I got some some kind of spicy Ramen that had a few pieces of tasty pork Charsiu along with ground pork and veggies. I had them add one of those soft boiled eggs into it. It came loaded with noodles and a broth so good I could of bathed in it. If I lived out this way, I'd go here often. Really nice people running the place also.Very affordable. A very satisfying filling bowl along with a pop for less than $20.00.

Very fun spot if you're into arcade games and an amazing time. Try some of the delicious beers on tap while you play a variety of different arcade games, pinball, ski ball, ddr, retro games and an outdoor area with shuffleboard and giant jenga/connect 4 for even more fun. They have daily specials too!
Extremely friendly and attentive staff staff (we has a bad experience last night at another spot). Food was good. No wait whatsoever to get into the joint. Definitely recommend!

Order via phone ahead of time, the wait is usually long on weeknights.
Delicious Mexican food, haven't been disappointed yet, only in the styrofoam takeout containers.
Food has always been consistent, flavorful and yummy.

Really cool spot and it was my first time here! How do you mess up a 22oz beer and endless fries? Answer is you cant and between that and the awesome burger this was an awesome spot. I ordered the smoke and pepper burger which was very tasty and a side salad while my dad got the endless fries. We also ordered the blue cheese crumble boneless wings which were tasty. Honestly would recommend and definitely coming back.

This is a prime example that you dont get what you pay for. Very pricey small portions subpar quality. All proteins were old tasting. Lemon grass soup contained neither. Yakatori was miniscule, all dark meat even skin. Spring rolls were empty. Fooled me once, not again.

If you ever visit ask for Emily! The food was great but the service outshined the entire restaurant. I rarely received that much attention but she made sure my glass never got empty and her amazing energy and charisma lifted this restaurant above others. During Mardi Gras it normal to get lower quality service but this place went above and beyond! Thank you Emily we will be returning before we leave the city

Different vibe. Large clean and modern bar atmosphere. We had the filet mignon. Cooked to perfection and was incredible! The service was great too! 
Only thing that we didn't like was the chocolate soufflé. It was over baked and very dry.  Other than that, all was good.
I really wanted to like this place, but everything was just salty. The wings, salty. The pizza, salty. The crust was great, but everything else was just way too salty.

Despite requesting for vegetarian food, we were given a Penang curry with fish sauce. Admit that you cannot make it without fish sauce instead of cheating your customer! Will never order from here. Spoilt our celebration this evening with a fishy sauce taking over . It went to trash.

Wow. If ever I had a "best of times/worst of times" experience at a restaurant, this was it. My vegan/GF friend swore by this place, and after looking it up on Yelp, I told her we should definitely go.

Things started out fine, seated and greeted warmly by our server. I ordered a drink and some Pão de Queijo, which was wonderful, to start. Shortly after, another couple sat down at the table next to us and ordered. Out came our appetizer, followed by our next-door-neighbors' drinks. A different server then took our dinner order, and I mentioned my drink to her, as my friend spotted our original guy outside on his phone. She actually mentioned it to the new server, who told us "he doesn't have these tables anymore."

Out came our food. Still no drink, but by this time I'd decided I didn't really need it (next stop Vaughan's, 'nuff said). I got the Esmeralda salad, a seemingly never-ending pile of greens, quinoa, beans, and veggies in a honey-lime vinaigrette that was a little richer in honey than my taste. But it was good, very fresh and light. My friend ordered white beans, the special that night. Pretty good, she said, but a bit bland, even with hot sauce. She kept trying, but eventually called someone over and asked if they could do something to jazz it up some. Then the manager came over and offered to remake it, suggesting adding some vegan sausage. Within a few minutes they brought it back, and after a taste, I agreed it was much better, delicious actually. We again menti

I was super excited to visit the Oink Cafe, I anticipated all week, excited by the awesome menu and of course #Bacon.

If disappointment could recieve stars, It'd be 5. I ordered the club with honey bacon, on sourdough with fresh fries, and lettuce on the side.  My bread was stale, my bacon was old and dry, not even a hint of honey, my fries were double cooked and dried out crunchy, and my tomato was mushy.  

The best part of the meal was the fact that the meat was fresh and the lettuce was crisp. My friend had the exact disappointment aside from the fact herjaleno bacon was good and her bread fresh, save your time go to Bobo's a few miles down the road.

Been here 2 days in a row! Love this place and their friendly accommodating service. Treating us like family! This is a must pho place for a mom and pop place. Was never a fan of dress to impress for authenticity in the real good stuff.

This was my first time ordering ToGo food from Emmy. The food was excellent, but more importantly they were taking COVID seriously! The staff had on mask, gloves, and taking temperatures at the door! I felt safe ordering from this restaurant because of the precautions they were taking to make it a clean environment. Thank you. I will be ordering from here more often!

Just... Don't...

Waited 5 min for a hostess
Finally one showed up, we were two with a high chair and sat down, dirty menus and table

Waited
Waited

No high chair

Got up and asked the manager for a high chair

Waited 
Waited

No waitress
No waitress

Still no waitress

Got up and left, noone batted an eye or cared we were leaving. 

Granted it was Mother's day, but there were more than enough servers and/or staff and managers for a barely half full restaurant. As opposed to the Perkins we ended up at, understaffed but killed it.

Skip this place.
It needs an enema.

Let me begin by stating I have been at this hole in a wall watering he several occasions previously. Bit for some odd reason tonight was super awkward. Greeted my cousin and I and we ordered a beer. Then he carded me particularly, which was normal but odd he singled me out. Gave him my valid PA I.d. which he examines a for about 2-3 mins. Then rudely asks if I have anything else with my name on it. What?! Baffled I advise yes eveything in my wallet has my name on it. He then asked if I have anything with a picture and my name on it. What?! No I gave you a valid drivers licence and showed you my debit card... Then he attempts to save face and says boy you age well. Awkward. And I am supposed to tipthay treatment...I don't think so. I won't be back.

One of the best breakfast choices you can make in the area. It has a big menu, great food, and is priced very well. We ordered a few things to share and everything was really good. Pancakes, eggs Benny, and an omelette dissapeared quickly. The line on weekends tells the story.
Walk up window shop with plenty of picnic tables and a pretty big menu. I only tried one thing, but the cheesesteaks looked really good, and my food was done pretty quickly.
Amazing kale salad with blackened salmon!! Great service good atmosphere and food is delicious!

My fiancee and I went to Mellow Mushroom for dinner Saturday night. If you want to avoid the typical national chains and get a quality pizza in a sit-down restaurant environment, this is the place.

We arrived around 6 or 7pm and got a table for 2. We could have been seated right away outside or the bar but decided to wait for an inside table. That wait was only about 15 minutes.

Mellow Mushroom has a cool vibe to it. A very psychedelic, hippie, subtle use of the mushrooms to infer a certain "state of mind". They pride themselves on all-natural ingredients. They also offer gluten free and vegan options.

Our server was around quick and took our drink orders and then an appetizer. We got the bruschetta. They only offer paper straws and we had to ask for regular ones. Some paper straws are better than others and these ones tend to just fall apart at the bottom and the top. We're all for saving the environment, just don't like eating paper. However they do not even keep regular plastic straws in stock. We were given children's cup straws.

The bruschetta was excellent. Crispy pieces of bread stacked with tomatoes, basil, feta cheese and balsamic vinegar. Tasted fresh and it was really good!

For our dinner, we ordered the Mighty Meat pizza in the medium size. This 6 slice pizza had a flavorful red sauce with fresh mozzarella, pepperoni, sausage, ground beef, ham and bacon. With the many toppings, it's not overwhelming, not too salty but meaty for sure. The cheese was also perfe

For my first yelp review ever. Sadly, i feel the need to give this lounge a 1 star. I was very disappointed in service. We were judged right from the gate. My husband and I decided to go for a few beers and a meal. We are a younger couple (the bar had an older crowd in which we typically like places like this, more our style) We sat at the bar for over an hour gambling. Our meals were mediocre and we had two drinks each. Time came when we had asked for the bill and were charged more for our drinks then meals put together! To top it off, sitting next to a women whom had a few drinks as well and when asked what she owed for her drinks she was quietly told her drinks were comped. She possibly could have been a regular but that doesn't make this ok. (They have no idea our intentions or what resides in our pocket book. I took much offense to this) My husband and I live very close and was excited to try a new place we could possibly eat lunch and gamble a little bit. I just have to say the bartender (J.R.) quickly judged and was not very pleasant. We will not be going back to this lounge. I felt the need to express to everyone that they also do not comp drinks and food was all the more just thrown together. I'm sure this place will continue on this way, as they are next to a golf course and most likely have they're "regulars." I feel piece of mind letting others whom are not familiar with this lounge my experience. Please do as you all wish with this info. Shananagins right down th

I used to love this place... I had it a few weeks back and it just wasn't the same as I remember it. So I gave them another try just to be sure and it was the same. The pork belly bacos were ok just "ok". I've had better from other restaurants. The pork rolls were soggy. They were a mess. I was mad I spent my money on them. The kimchi fries were even better before. I felt like this time around they skimpt on the meat. Im not willing to try them again. I gave them two chances and it just wasn't up to par. I wouldn't waste my time or my money here.

I am not a fan of the food (very few options for vegetarians) at all but they do have great drink specials and the Tuesday night Drag shows are amazing! My friends and I love going out for the Drag Karaoke night at Split Rail! It is such a fun atmosphere! Highly recommend checking out the show!

I grew up with Spanish grandparents and have been to Spain many times. I was skeptical about this place at first, Nashville isn't exactly known for Spanish food but this place is the real deal. We had 8 different plates and everything was really good. I have not a single complaint and every single dish stood out. Definitely worth your time! Wish this kind of Spanish food was accessible in Los Angeles! Enjoy!

Best hot and sour soup I have EVER had. We ordered our medium spicy and it was just absolutely perfect. The lo mein was also excellent, but we like ours thicker and firmer than some serve it. Egg rolls were good, but unique in texture and may not be for everyone. The fried dumplings were made differently than I've ever seen them done. They were much larger, flatter, and more.... flacid (?), than I've seen - but they were damn delicious. Very well cooked meat inside and that's important to me. I didn't love the meat used for the sesame chicken though. Tasted dark and stringy like old chicken thighs... or something. I didn't eat more than one or two pieces and then grossed myself out thinking it tasted like the rat I tried in Australia. Threw the rest away. My son loved his sweet and sour chicken though. My husband shared my experience with his king pao chicken. We prefer chicken breast I guess. We'd go here again but I wouldn't get a chicken dish. I bet the vegetable lo mein is perfect.

I love Chick-fil-A and I love the convenience of ordering ahead and not having to wait in that ridiculously long line. 
They do try and speed it up by having two lanes but boy it just didn't seem to move. 
Order ahead, tell them what space you're in and in a few minutes a friendly staff member will bring you your food.

They make a good James and the Giant Peach vegetarian sandwich I need to rest. Dutch crust is the most tasty of the breads.  We always have them add onions and jalapenos to it also. It's $10, 8 inch long sandwich and we can usually split it a bag of chips.
Finally, a healthy fast choice!  I have loved everything I've tried, Korean BBQ bowl is my favorite. The sipping broth is full of flavor, tastes nothing like the store bought boxed kind.

I've been out of town for several months due to covid. I knew the storm was coming so I figured..I'll order indian so I have plenty of leftovers for the next few days I won't want to leave the house anyway! 
My go-to indian spot has closed...so I figured I'll order from the next highest rated. I got butter chicken and saag paneer with some naan, all medium heat.
The saag was great, naan also great (but when is bread not good) my qualms were with the butter chicken. The chicken was dry, far too spicy (and I like spice) and had a flavor I wasn't expecting. Completely tossed the chicken..that was a waste. The rice was also very dry - it wasn't good to start and then reheating completely ruined it.
Service was fast, food showed up exactly when expected! But next time I'll try somewhere else...

Ok. The food was good, not great , but good.  

The experience was awful. There was a total of 5 of us there tonight. The first of us got there early and went to the bar, sat for 10 minutes and was ignored by the staff. Once our whole party was there we sat and waited for about 10 min before the kid waiting on us came over. ( there was no other customers) . He took our drink orders. 3 waters and 2 teas, that took about 10 minutes for him to do. He takes our orders and half way through he stops us to go get a pen and paper...... so he takes our orders , 1 burger with the works, 2 pulled pork sandwiches and a catfish sandwich with a side of tartar.

55 Minutes passed before we see our waiter again...  he brings out the food, one plate at a time with about a 5 minute wait between each... the pork was fine but the burger with the works was literally meat on a bun and nothing else, when he asked for the toppings they brought him some pickles and catsup.... the fish also came with no toppings and I had to re ask for my side. We are while he disappeared again... 

During this whole time there was one other dine in group of 2, and 2 dine out orders, but a group of 5 or so of the employee's friends just hanging out...  very poor service ..

The table was dirty and the store is a dive. I don't expect they'll be around very long.   

If you want to eat there, call around lunch time for your dinner order.

Our baby sitter ordered take out (appx $25) and delivery person said they had no change... for $40... Really.

We always tip our deliver people generously bc it's a hard but a 60% tip. Not okay dude.
Awesome atmosphere, music was very chill and had slight hip hop vibes, the food was amazing.

I went to Campo's 20 minutes before closing last night. We got there at 8:40 and they close at 9. They closed early and wouldn't even come to the door. I went to Paesano's instead and had a wonderful gluten free cheesesteak!

I went there at 3 am and easily the best food from McDonald's that I can remember . I expected cold fries and a stale burger but the fries were fresh and the burger was really good. Good job whoever was working there that night!
Actually the best place ever!!!! So much fun. Throw it back to the 1920s. Ask for Brittany!!!!!!
Our food was delicious! Everything was so fresh and moist (both had the Western Omelet). Everything was quick and served right away. Will be back!
